referenceDna.annotatedDescription: The direct Ivy Homecare Services website in London, England uses caregiver photograph with a compact white message over a deep green field. Navigation is plain service menu and early contact links. Its page moves through care-photo opening, independence explanation, benefit feature, service menu, support process, care promise, contact, with many care options arranged as a clear list of practical support. person-centred care photographs balanced against clean green panels. Transferable mechanics are forest-green service field, care-photo hero, support timing explanation. The brand identity, people, photographs, reviews, wording and business claims remain source-only.
